name: Three trials, three horizons

date.label: Original World of Warcraft Onyxia story before the Wrath raid rerelease

summary: Three guardians stand in lands far apart: Chronalis beneath the Tanaris sun, Scryer amid Winterspring snow, and Somnus beneath the Swamp of Sorrows’ green canopy. Each place holds its own weather and color, and each dragon bears one part of the trial Emberstrife set. With the three skulls gathered, the Horde can complete his charge and carry Myranda’s borrowed shape toward the black dragon’s mountain.
